# Final Verification

## Newest current-tree authority

The newest mobile-sheet/full-platform command completed with exit code 0 and marker `FULL_PLATFORM_MOBILE_SHEET_GREEN`.

### Structural/mobile preflight

- `sheet.css`: 10 lines.
- `sheetLayout.css`: 83 lines.
- `sheetContent.css`: 87 lines.
- CSS contract + focus lifecycle + product-memory preflight: 13/13 passing.

### Complete platform groups in that command

- Apps/Games/shared-commerce group: 45/45 passing.
- Wallet/reconciliation/Radiance-copy group: 52/52 passing.
- Static/SEO/startup group: 10/10 passing.

The complete platform groups therefore total 107/107 passing in the newest authority. The 13-test preflight is additional and intentionally overlaps some already-counted tests.

## Derived public truth regenerated

- Apps: 81.
- Games: 33.
- Public discovery records: 114.
- Generated shards: 15.
- Sitemap public routes: 99.

## Focus/mobile hardening

- Commerce focus lifecycle unit behavior is green.
- Real mobile browser launcher click succeeded.
- Real mobile close-button click succeeded.
- Exact active-element browser introspection was not available through the current tunnel evaluator adapter; lifecycle tests therefore remain the precise focus-return evidence.
- Shared sheet now enforces 44px close and account/Wallet targets, footer wrapping, safe-area-aware width, bottom safe area, horizontal containment, long-text wrapping, and narrow-screen coexistence with the full-width Favorite control.

## Monetization hardening

- 80 discovered monetizable products.
- 80 live Radiance capabilities.
- 240 product-credit packs.
- Radiance remains 25 credits, permanent, durable, server-authoritative, and handler-backed.
- Game offer copy explicitly rejects gameplay advantage.
- App offer copy explicitly states that functionality is unchanged.
- Dedicated Radiance product-copy / authority / settlement gate: 14/14 passing before inclusion in the full platform suite.

## Wallet/economic safety

- Reservation/commit/release state machine preserved.
- Current-account reconciliation health is authenticated GET-only, text/plain, no-store, read-only, and identity-free.
- Stale holds and impossible execution/reservation topology are detectable.
- Legitimate already-owned permanent unlock deduplication is not misclassified.

## Performance truth

- Isolated full server reached HTTP readiness in roughly eight seconds.
- Explicit startup lifecycle awaits together were only milliseconds.
- Module composition/loading is the dominant measured delay.
- No readiness semantics were weakened to manufacture a smaller number.

## Public availability

Awtsmoos.com, Apps, Games, and Transcription Studio are publicly reachable over HTTPS as of 2026-09-11. Exact parity between every newest local hardening file and the production server has not been proven because production is a separate SHA-locked checkout and the current local tree is not a safe release source.
